content: Xooss goynnonnee bonchcho kumeez de7or asayis, woossodayis, guurodayisnnee galatodayis beezizana taanii nena zoriza.
Nuunii lo77o ayyana yessarannee geeshshetithar Xooss goynnittar sarotithirannee dacc geez yess yezoday garkk kaatitayisinnee shuumitay ubbayis woossoytta.
Yey garkk woosay nuna ashshiza Xoossay tiina lo77onnee ufayssizabazii.
Xoossii as ubbay attoday garkkennee tuma eroday garkk koyiza.
Pettii Xooss yeza. Xoossisinnee asis gancce maaqqii dabothiza pettay yeza; eekka as maaqqeez Kiristtoosa Yesuusa.
E as ubba wozodayis fana aathii inggeeza. Xoossii fa woder as ubba wozodayis koyizana beeziza markkay yhaya.
Xoossii tana Wonggiles asitamaarennee hawaare udii dooreezay yeyisii. Taanii tuma odiza; worddotooya; ammanonnee tuma qaala Ayihude maaqqekka asayis taamarisodayigarkk Xoossii tana shuumeeza.
Yeyi gishos, ubba aqo yez dhiirathitay, fana Xoossayis dummasii, wachchinnee kachch ashii, fa geezheez kucita afa denthii Xooss woossoday garkk koyiza.
Yey garkkekka maachchitay fa omma dathara woy worqqara woy inqqo worqqara woy al7o aflar fana buqquror baazin, yashatitharannee haayottithar beeziza womaanotith afila ma77o.
Zini Xoossayis ta goynniza giz maachchitay paas beezizay garkk lo77o baz ootho.
Maachchii ubba bazar kiitinttithar si77i gi tamaaro.
Taanii maachchitay tamaarssoday garkk woy dhiirathal afa mawute ekkoday garkk baazin si77i gi yezoday garkk koyiza.
Addaama tiina medhintteeza; guyeppe Hiwaanna medhintteeza.
Dooshintteezanannee Xooss higga mentheezan maachchatipp attin Addaama baaya.
Zini maachchii ammanor, siiqorannee geeshshatithar fana haarii yeziko na7ita yelor attoda.
